EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: වැɣ/ඉ/2/5/අƮපƮ/ඒ005(අමතර). Land Ministry Ref No.: LD/05/2011/HW/109.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose:- Description of the land to be acquired: In the province of Uva District of Badulla, Divisional Secretariat of Welimada, Minor Division of Uda palatha Korela, Grama Niladhari Division of Alakolagala, Village of Harakgamakanda, Surveyour General FVP 504, Supplement No. 15, Paper No. 15 and dated on 31.08.2018 Base Plot No. 995 the extent of 0.0013 Hectare the details as follow:

Lot No. 995 Name of the Land: Alakolagalawaththa; Land Details: Home Garden Part of a permanent building and mixed Cultivation about 15-20 year age; Claimant: Government; Original Claimant: A. C. M. Aliyar of Alakolagala; Extent: 0.0013 Hectare.
All persons interested in the aforesaid Land/lands on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to

appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat Office, Welimada on the date and time relevant to each land lot as writing (in duplicate) on or before the 10th day of December 2018, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, and the amount of computation and the details of the compensation of such amount.
Date Time Lot Numbers 2018.12.10 10.00 a. m. 995 W. M. C. WEERASINGHE, Divisional Secretary, Welimada.
Divisional Secretary’s Office, Welimada, On 14th November 2018. 11-1361/1
